invariants.statement: Every resolver-affecting Cargo process starts outside the developer home-directory ancestry.
invariants.acceptance: scripts/run-cargo-hermetic.sh changes directory to the filesystem root before exec

invariants.statement: Every resolver-affecting Cargo process receives a repository-local isolated Cargo home.
invariants.acceptance: scripts/run-cargo-hermetic.sh exports its isolated Cargo home

invariants.statement: The isolated Cargo home contains no ambient Cargo configuration.
invariants.acceptance: the launcher rejects config and config.toml inside its isolated Cargo home

invariants.statement: The repository manifest is addressed by an absolute path after changing working directory.
invariants.acceptance: every supported launcher branch supplies the absolute repository manifest

invariants.statement: Cargo targets and temporary artifacts are stored below the repository target directory.
invariants.acceptance: the launcher exports repository-backed CARGO_TARGET_DIR and TMPDIR values

invariants.statement: Dependency resolution is offline for every supported Cargo command.
invariants.acceptance: the launcher exports CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true and supplies --offline when supported

invariants.statement: The launcher preserves the underlying Cargo process exit status.
invariants.acceptance: the launcher replaces itself with Cargo using exec

invariants.statement: No verification evidence is accepted after Cargo changes the repository lockfile.
invariants.acceptance: standard commands use --locked and the Kani verifier compares lockfile hashes after every harness
